subject: EdgeWave onboarding – stage-gate action slate and next steps
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Charlie Morales <charlie.morales@edgewave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: EdgeWave onboarding – proposed stage-gate slate

Hi Charlie —

Great to meet earlier. To keep the pilot (evaluation) tight and predictable, we put together a short stage-gate action slate that maps to the MAP items you asked for: org setup, API keys, IP allowlist, and VPC peering. I attached the spreadsheet (EdgeWave_MAP_v1.xlsx) with proposed owners and target dates.

High-level milestones I want to confirm now so we can lock dates:
- Org & tenant seeded (EdgeWave admin + Redwood service account) — target: 05/14
- API key issuance (ephemeral keys for test app + prod-like key rotation doc) — target: 05/17
- IP allowlist + firewall rules (EdgeWave provides ranges; Redwood will confirm egress endpoints) — target: 05/18
- VPC peering (optional for private deployment; otherwise use allowlist) — target: 05/20
- Smoke tests and acceptance run (sample requests, latency checks, token-cost sanity) — target: 05/21

As discussed, we recommend starting with hosted sandbox (fastest) and then toggle to dedicated capacity during the final acceptance window if perf/cost warrant. Karthik (cc'd) will own the peering playbook and technical handoffs; Ben owns the mutual action cadence/sales ops.

Ask: please confirm the owner on your side for networking (I put a placeholder in the sheet) and whether the EdgeWave security team needs a SOC2 artifact before we issue ephemeral keys. If yes, we can provide our SOC2 summary and redaction-friendly evidence links.

Call to action: can you confirm owners and ack the milestone targets by EOD 05/12 so we can book the onboarding slots?

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: EdgeWave_MAP_v1.xlsx
From: Charlie Morales <charlie.morales@edgewave.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Park <alice.park@edgewave.com>, EdgeWave - Network Team <netops@edgewave.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T10:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeWave onboarding – proposed stage-gate slate

Vanessa —

Thanks, this looks good and aligns with our internal timeline. Quick notes from our side:
- Network owner: adding our network lead Alice Park (cc). She'll provide the IP ranges by EOD 05/13.
- SOC2: we have a standard checklist; we can review Redwood's SOC2 summary before keys. Please send the summary and any high-level data handling notes.
- VPC peering: our preferred route is allowlist first; peering only if we need private link performance.

Two scheduling asks:
1) Can we lock a 60-minute onboarding session the week of 05/17? Prefer Tue or Wed morning PT.
2) We will need an engineer-to-engineer deep-dive on VPC peering specifics if we pursue peering; suggest Karthik + our netops for that session.

I reviewed the sheet and the targets look reasonable. We'll confirm the owner and IP ranges by 05/13.

Cheers,
Charlie Morales
Head of Platform Integrations
EdgeWave

--- Forwarded network contact ---
From: EdgeWave NetOps <netops@edgewave.com>
Subject: NetOps contact for peering
Body: Please work with netops@edgewave.com for firewall config and peering tickets.
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Charlie Morales <charlie.morales@edgewave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-15T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeWave onboarding – stage-gate action slate (updated MAP & SOW link)

Charlie / Alice / NetOps —

Thanks for the quick ack and for looping in Alice. I updated the MAP with explicit owners and added a short risk/acceptance column (see attached). I've also dropped a draft SOW into the drive and included a DocuSign pre-fill link below for the typical pilot terms; we leave budgets and commit windows blank until you confirm the evaluation scale.

Summary of changes in the attached MAP:
- Owner column filled: EdgeWave (Alice) for IP ranges; Redwood (Karthik) for peering runbook; Redwood (Ben) for MAP cadence and billing touchpoints.
- Added 'Key gating artifact' column: SOC2 summary, network diagram, and required contact for peering ticket.
- Acceptance criteria refined: successful 1000-sample generation test with <=200ms median token latency under the sandbox quota.

Links and artifacts: 
- MAP sheet: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-EdgeWave-Onboard-Shared
- SOW (draft): https://app.docusign.com/link/SOW-Redwood-EdgeWave-Draft

Attachments included in this email: SOW-Redwood-EdgeWave-draft.pdf, EdgeWave_MAP_v1.xlsx

Next steps / asks:
- Alice / NetOps: please share the IP CIDR ranges and any NAT/outbound proxy details by 05/18 so Karthik can map endpoints.
- Charlie: if SOC2 summary is required, Neha (cc) will route the appropriate redaction-friendly artifact. Please confirm scope.
- Confirm a 60-min onboarding slot: Karthik suggested 05/19 09:30 PT or 05/20 10:00 PT — which works for your engineers?

If we get IP ranges by 05/18 and the onboarding call on 05/19, we can meet the smoke test target on 05/21.

On the DocuSign flow: signing the pilot SOW enables reserved onboarding capacity but does not commit to long-term spend; we can toggle to a trial agreement if preferred.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-Redwood-EdgeWave-draft.pdf; EdgeWave_MAP_v1.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Charlie Morales <charlie.morales@edgewave.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeWave onboarding – stage-gate action slate and next steps

Quick note —

Confirmed the 05/19 09:30 PT onboarding slot with Karthik and the infra team. Karthik will lead the peering/readiness portion and run the smoke test checklist during the call. Charlie — we will expect the IP ranges from Alice by 05/18 so the preflight checks are meaningful.

I'll also create the HubSpot milestone and set automated reminders for the MAP owners so nothing drifts. I added the deal id (DW-4382) and linked the shared drive.

On SOC2: Neha, please prepare the redaction-friendly SOC2 summary and post the link to the shared folder once ready.

Ben Carter
Enterprise AE
Redwood Inference
